# SotoR Executive

> Premium chauffeur service based in Zurich, Switzerland: Zurich Airport (ZRH) transfers, business and VIP rides, group and ski transfers, long-distance rides across Switzerland and international rides to France, Italy and Germany.

- Legal name: Soto Ramirez Transporte (operating as SotoR Executive)
- Base: Zürich, Canton of Zurich, Switzerland
- Languages spoken: English, German, Spanish
- Booking: request form on the website or WhatsApp +41 77 227 04 76; every ride is confirmed with a fixed price in advance
- Clients: private travellers, companies, hotels, travel agencies, DMCs and transfer platforms (corporate invoicing available)

## Fleet

- Mercedes-Benz EQE 300: 100% electric, 1–3 passengers, business & VIP
- Mercedes V-Class: up to 7 passengers, lots of luggage, families & ski groups
- Tesla Model S: 100% electric, 1–3 passengers, business

## Services

- Zurich Airport (ZRH) transfers with flight monitoring: pickup time adjusts to the actual landing
- Business & VIP chauffeur service: meetings, events, hotels
- Group and ski transfers, several vans coordinated if needed
- Long-distance rides from Zurich to every region of Switzerland
- International rides from Zurich to France, Italy and Germany
- Child seats on request; professional drivers with full passenger transport insurance
